rows.description: VP gate for every countdown win: the owner needs at least this many VP at the announce and at the confirmation.
Act I ends at the end of the turn in which any seat reaches this many VP.
Act I ends when this round ends, if no seat reached tune.act1-end-vp first.
Act II ends at the end of the turn in which any seat reaches this many VP.
Act II ends when this round ends, if no seat reached tune.act2-end-vp first.
The Monolith Number shown on the Monolith clearing is this minus the top score, so it ticks down as anyone scores.
Games in the optional linked campaign (Act I, Act II, Act III).
Extra cards the human draws at setup after losing the previous campaign game (the last expedition's journal).
Pips on Gustave's Arm; the Arm must be full for his win and to arm Overcharge.
Distinct suits (of fox, rabbit and mouse) his ruled Chain must cover.
Marquise buildings a ruled clearing needs to receive an Expedition Flag at the end of his turn.
Marquise buildings the Beachhead (a Chain clearing next to the Monolith) must hold at both checks.
Extra hits Overcharge gives in the armed battle.
Gustave's bot enters goal mode at this many VP (Normal and Hard).
Gustave's bot also enters goal mode once its Route cost is at most this.
Gustave's Easy bot enters goal mode at this many VP.
Gustave's Hard bot keeps at least this margin of rule on every Chain clearing.
Route cost of a clearing he rules that has a free slot but no flag (a flagged, ruled clearing costs 0).
Route cost of a clearing he does not rule, before adding 1 per enemy warrior there.
Extra Route cost when enemy buildings fill a clearing's slots.
Rocks Esquie must hold to win (Florrie, Dorrie, Soarrie, Urrie).
Guard warriors spawned with Florrie at Stone Wave Cliffs at setup.
Guard warriors spawned with Urrie at Esquie's Nest.

1 = guards spawn from the Nevron host; 0 = the no-spawn fallback (no guards; Florrie and Urrie are claimable only when no other faction has warriors in their clearing). Set to 0 if the week-1 spike shows the mod cannot place another seat's warriors.
Undamaged swords his Bag counts as for max hits in a clearing with a guarded rock.
Esquie's bot target cost = path distance + this x GuardsLeft - his max hits there.
Esquie's bot repairs in a forest first once this many items are damaged.
If no claimable rock is within this many moves, Esquie's bot plays normal Vagabond VP.
Guard battles per turn for Esquie's bot (Easy and Normal).
Guard battles per turn for Esquie's Hard bot.
Rocks held at which Esquie's bot goes straight for the last one (and the host and other bots start defending it).
Her warriors a roost clearing needs to be a Living Portrait.
Her roosts the Monolith must hold at both checks.
Warriors Still Life moves into a Living Portrait clearing (v1.1).
The Paintress's bot enters finish mode at this many VP (with tune.paintress-finish-portraits Portraits).
Living Portraits the Paintress's bot needs before finish mode.
Warriors the Paintress's Hard bot garrisons on each Portrait.
Warriors the Paintress's bot keeps in the Monolith.
Turns the Paintress's bot avoids rebuilding a destroyed Portrait in the same clearing.
Site score bonus for a candidate Portrait clearing next to a clearing she rules.
Site score bonus for a candidate within tune.paintress-site-near-monolith-steps of the Monolith.
Path steps from the Monolith that count as near for the site score.
Site score per enemy warrior in a candidate clearing.
Site score for a candidate holding a guarded rock (the host may not build there).
Sanctuaries needed at the announce, and Lantern clearings without enemy buildings or tokens needed at the confirmation.
Aquafarms (bases) that must stand on the map at both checks.
Extra hits Twilight gives her first battle of an Evening (v1.1).
Sciel's bot enters finish mode at this many Sanctuaries.
Base score of a Spread candidate, before subtracting enemy pieces there and enemy warriors adjacent.
Spread score bonus when the candidate's suit has no Sanctuary yet.
Sciel's bot never spreads into a clearing with this many or more enemy pieces.
Matching supporters Sciel's bot keeps ready for a Revolt.
Sciel's Easy bot evicts only with at least this many of her warriors per enemy piece.
Perfection rank S as a number (D=0, C=1, B=2, A=3, S=4); the top of the clamp and the rank his win needs.
From this rank (A) up, Perfection adds a hit when he attacks.
Extra hits Perfection gives once per battle when attacking.
Rank a human Verso on Easy needs instead of S (with tune.verso-easy-swords undamaged swords). Never for bots.
Undamaged swords a human Verso on Easy needs to count rank A as S.
Rank gained after a battle where he removed an enemy piece with no item damaged.
Rank lost after a battle in which 1 to tune.verso-heavy-damage - 1 of his items were damaged.
Rank lost after a battle in which tune.verso-heavy-damage or more of his items were damaged.
Items damaged in one battle that count as heavy damage for the rank.
VP Verso scores when Soarrie passes to Esquie.
Below rank A, Verso's bot starts a battle only when the hits it expects to take are under this.
A defender holding this many cards is treated as a possible Ambush by Verso's bot.
Undamaged swords Verso's bot wants before fighting a possible Ambush.
Verso's bot assaults the Monolith only when expected damage is under this.
Undamaged swords Verso's Easy bot waits for before assaulting the Monolith.
Non-Vagabond factions Maelle must be Allied with (when 2+ are seated).
Undamaged items (exhausted ones count) Maelle needs in Lumière.
VP Maelle needs instead of tune.countdown-vp when only one non-Vagabond faction is seated.
Maelle's bot re-picks its family only if a family member passes this many VP.
Maelle's bot fights a non-Hostile faction only if it is within this many VP of winning.
Distinct relic types (tablet, figure, jewelry) among her recovered relics for her win.
Extra hits an armed Stain gives.
Warriors Lune's bot wants next to the Journal's forest before delving it.
Minimum warriors in a convoy carrying a relic (Normal and Hard; Easy sends single carriers).
Feet on the Bestial Wheel (Agile, Caster, Balanced, Heavy, Almighty).
Distinct source factions his feet must come from (or every opponent if fewer are seated).
Act from which the Almighty foot can be earned.
Pieces of the VP leader removed in one battle that earn Almighty (instead of a leader building).
Battle score bonus for Monoco's bot when the battle fills a missing foot.
Battle score bonus when it adds a new faction toward the 3-faction rule.
Monoco's bot targets enemy buildings or tokens guarded by at most this many warriors for Heavy and Caster.
Gestrals Monoco's bot keeps escorting the Warlord once it has tune.monoco-bot-escort-after-feet feet.
Feet after which Monoco's bot escorts the Warlord.
Monoco's Easy bot advances only when the Warlord outnumbers the defenders by this many.
Duchy tunnels the Monolith must hold at both checks.
Warriors the Curator needs in Lumière when no keep stands there and he has no building there.
Cards drawn by a player who removes the Paintress's roost from the Monolith.
Warriors the Curator's bot stocks in the Burrow during Acts I-II.
The Curator's bot attacks the Monolith or Lumière with defenders plus this many warriors.
The Curator's Easy bot attacks Lumière only with defenders plus this many warriors.
Different clearings her (non-guard) warriors must stand in. Lower to 7 if the Lizard Recruit ritual proves narrower.
Gardens (ateliers) the Flying Manor must hold at both checks.
Clea's bot enters goal mode at this many covered clearings.
Clea's bot sacrifices bird cards for acolytes only while holding at least this many birds.
The White-Haired Man's bot enters goal mode at this many VP.
Margin of warriors the Hard bot keeps in every Ring clearing.
Enemy warriors gathered in or beside the Ring that make the bot place a Bomb there.
Hits his Ring warriors ignore in each battle during Act I.
